playbookOutputs: Comprehensive CIPC & SARS Compliance Health Check Report detailing company status, CIPC Annual Return arrears, Beneficial Ownership status, and SARS tax compliance across Income Tax, VAT, and PAYE/UIF/SDL
Actionable Remediation Plan & Itemised Quote to clear any non-compliance blocks
playbookCommonFailures: Company registration number or ID number provided is inaccurate or cannot be located on CIPC
SARS eFiling credentials are not provided or OTP is not relayed to inspect the full SARS My Compliance Profile (MCP)

informationToProvide.label: Company Name & CIPC Registration Number (or Individual Name & SA ID Number)
informationToProvide.helpText: Provide your registered company name and CIPC registration number (e.g., 2020/123456/07) or your full name and 13-digit SA ID number.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Company name and CIPC registration number, or individual full name and SA ID number.

informationToProvide.label: SARS Income Tax, VAT & PAYE Reference Numbers (if known)
informationToProvide.helpText: Provide your SARS tax reference numbers and let us know what compliance issues you are experiencing (e.g., CIPC AR deregistration, non-compliant TCS PIN, outstanding returns).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Known SARS tax reference numbers and client notes on compliance concerns.

informationToProvide.label: CIPC Registration Certificate (CoR 14.3) or Director SA ID Copy (optional)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload your CIPC CoR 14.3 or SA ID document if available.
informationToProvide.aiHint: CIPC CoR 14.3 certificate or SA ID document.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Username
informationToProvide.helpText: Your SARS eFiling login username (or confirm if My Accountant already has Registered Representative / Tax Practitioner shared access).
informationToProvide.aiHint: SARS eFiling username for the taxpayer profile or confirmation of shared Tax Practitioner access.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Password
informationToProvide.helpText: Encrypted and restricted to authorized filing staff and the SARS eFiling automation worker.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling OTP Required? (Yes / No)
informationToProvide.helpText: Does logging into your SARS eFiling profile trigger a One-Time PIN (OTP) to your cellphone or email?
informationToProvide.aiHint: Whether 2FA OTP relay is required when logging into SARS eFiling.

informationToProvide.label: Best Time to Contact for SARS OTP
informationToProvide.helpText: Select a date and time window when you will be available to relay the real-time SARS OTP within the 10-minute eFiling timeout.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Preferred date/time window to coordinate real-time SARS eFiling OTP relay.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect CIPC registration number, SARS tax numbers and optional eFiling access
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Company registration number / ID number and SARS details collected
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Confirm the CIPC registration number and whether SARS eFiling credentials have been supplied for a full My Compliance Profile audit.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Audit CIPC registration status, Annual Return arrears and Beneficial Ownership standing
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CIPC enterprise status (In Business / AR Deregistration / Final Deregistered), outstanding Annual Return years/fees, and BO status recorded
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Look up the enterprise on CIPC eServices / BizPortal to verify current status, outstanding Annual Return years and fees/penalties, and Beneficial Ownership declaration status.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Audit SARS My Compliance Profile (MCP) across all registered tax types
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: SARS compliance status (outstanding returns and debt balances across Income Tax, VAT, PAYE) documented
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: If SARS eFiling credentials or Tax Practitioner access are available, inspect My Compliance Profile (MCP) to list every outstanding return and unpaid balance per tax type.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Compile CIPC & SARS Compliance Health Check Report and Remediation Plan
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Structured Compliance Health Check Report and itemised remediation quote approved by Kevin
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Prepare a clear, structured Compliance Health Check summary covering (1) CIPC Status & Annual Returns/BO, (2) SARS Compliance Status (ITR14/ITR12, IRP6, VAT201, EMP201/EMP501, Debt/Penalties), and (3) Step-by-step recommended actions and fees to restore full compliance.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver CIPC & SARS Compliance Health Check Report to client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Health Check Report posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Post the complete CIPC & SARS Compliance Health Check Report to Communication History.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the Free SARS & CIPC Assessment order is complete
